source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Note 15 Income Taxes, income taxes paid by jurisdiction
source.quote: Net income tax payments after the prospective adoption of ASU 2023-09, as described in Note 1, consisted of the following (in millions): Year Ended December 31, 2025 United States - federal 1 $ 1,291 United States - state and local 127 International: Brazil 238 India 265 Mexico 280 Other foreign 672 Total income taxes paid, net of refunds $ 2,873 [USD millions]

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Taxes: total income taxes paid, net of refunds, from the by-jurisdiction table in the income-tax note (ASU 2023-09); the 10-K no longer states it in the old 'income tax payments' sentence for 2025, and no XBRL fact was found at the new year end, so there is no xbrl object. R&D: the 10-K reports no research and development expense line, so rnd is null.
